title: Prove a 3r-1 compact-switch guard cover from terminal cancellations (no κ)
body:
The conservative compact-switch guard cover in Nick Petalas's PR6231 requires 3r+1 coordinate translations. This isolated research package composes two credited terminal-cancellation facts with arbitrary target-omitting source functions and proves an optimal **3r−1 cover of the relaxed product predicate**. For one target, two phases suffice and no data translation is needed.

Both local mechanisms are predecessor results: John-Michael Smith's PR763 terminal source carry, and Hanson Sun's seed73/PR1219 unguarded highest window. The new claim is the arbitrary-function composition and exact relaxed cover, including source transport and an endpoint-invariant logical selector. Optimality concerns this sufficient predicate, not the whole raw agreement set. See `research/terminal-carry-guard-cover/PROOF.md`.

The picker selected `uniform-transfer-audit`, nonce `930100c482c571e578d56c96d62de0a7`. Its first baseline passed. Scope explicitly changed to an alternate logical CRT interface tied to analytic recovery. This does not discharge a selected assumption, admit PR4100 or change κ. Physical translations, selector, controlled execution, shuttles and cleanup remain unpriced. No physical expansion is proposed without that bill.

Canonical main was refreshed at `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, revision 8, selected #6030. Live handoffs/discussions and open PRs were checked before selection; targeted cached overlap covered 761 open PRs, 6,882 discussion records and all 8,917 tracked local notes. PR6231 and its completed handoff are direct predecessors. Prior PR6811 is distinct tooling work. Frozen sources and selected records are unchanged.

Validation on Linux x86_64:

- CPython 3.12.9 registered normal and isolated optimized replay passed with identical receipts: `python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/terminal-carry-guard-cover`.
- 65,536 exhaustive one-window Boolean-source endpoints; 6,144 sampled dirty multi-field endpoints; 6,144 guarded forced control wraps; four exact compressed cover geometries; 416 menu-adversary fixtures; five rejecting controls and a simultaneous data/control wrap positive control.
- Metadata/pins, committed bytes, Git modes, source-history ancestry and `git diff --check` passed. Direct CPython 3.10.12 replay also passed.
- No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, human review or formal-kernel acceptance claimed. Hosted CI is separate.

Prepared for Benny Zhao / zhaobenny with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation and writing; no subagents. Apache-2.0. Full predecessor credit, exact pins, bounded stop rule and Open next questions are in the package.

Canonical investigation and physical-cost handoff: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/6813. Final complete overlap refresh covered 761 open PRs at 20:24:11 UTC and 6,882 discussion records at 20:25:48 UTC on November 6; no matching competing claim found.
